name: com.whatsonvegas/whats-on-vegas
title: What's On Vegas
description: What's on in Las Vegas: events, Strip hotel prices by night, hotel facts, casino loyalty tiers.

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: Events in Las Vegas between two dates (conventions with their expected attendance, big sports weekends, holidays) and what a typical Strip hotel costs on the nights we checked. Defaults to the next 7 days.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default today in Las Vegas

tools.name: event_details
tools.description: One Las Vegas event by name (e.g. "CES", "SHOT Show", "National Finals Rodeo", "Formula 1"): dates, venue, attendance, what Strip rooms cost those nights against a quiet night (nights_before and nights_after: the checked nights around it, e.g. the arrival night), the cheapest and dearest three-night stays, the closest Strip hotels on foot, and official, ticket and page links.

query.description: The event name or part of it

tools.name: hotel_prices
tools.description: What a typical Las Vegas Strip resort room costs on a given night, against a quiet midweek night checked at a similar lead time (quiet_night: its price, date and when it was checked, the same one vs_quiet_night divides by; baseline_quiet_night_usd is a separate rough average), what drives it, and whether that night is one for hotel points or cash. If the night was not sampled, returns the nearest checked nights.

tools.name: best_nights
tools.description: The cheapest checked nights for a Las Vegas Strip hotel in a date range, with what is on those nights. Defaults to the next four months.

tools.name: nightlife
tools.description: The main Las Vegas nightclubs, show venues and arenas, where they are, their official sites, and for the big clubs (TAO, Omnia, Hakkasan, LIV, XS, Drai's) the coming week's line-up from the club's own calendar.

tools.name: hotel_info
tools.description: One Las Vegas Strip hotel by name (e.g. "Bellagio", "Wynn", "Cosmopolitan", "MGM Grand"): how many rooms and when it opened, the nightclubs inside, its casino loyalty programme and hotel-chain link, whether rooms see the Grand Prix track, and the hotel's page on whatsonvegas.com. No prices: for what rooms cost on a night, use hotel_prices.

name.description: The hotel name or part of it

tools.name: loyalty_tiers
tools.description: Status tiers of the loyalty programmes at the Las Vegas Strip resorts (MGM Rewards, Caesars Rewards, Wynn Rewards, Venetian Rewards, Genting Rewards at Resorts World): what each tier takes and includes (room rates, upgrades, resort-fee waivers, priority lines), how status is earned and reset, status matches with hotel chains and cruise lines, which resorts belong to it, sources and the date checked. Accepts a programme or a hotel name. Read-only reference information.

programme.description: Programme name (e.g. "Caesars Rewards", "MGM") or a Strip hotel in it (e.g. "Bellagio")

tools.name: sky_now
tools.description: Live count of aircraft around Las Vegas right now (from adsb.lol): how many are descending towards Harry Reid International, climbing out, passing over, and helicopters, with a few examples.
